definitions.explanation: The act of taking part in an activity, event, or group.

examples.japanese: ⟦{会議|かいぎ}→会議：00710_kaigi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{参加|さんか}する。
{参加|さんか}⟦{費|ひ}→費：09877_hi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{無料|むりょう}→無料：01662_muryou⟧です。
⟦ぜひ→ぜひ：00911_zehi⟧ご{参加|さんか}⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。

notes:
{参加|さんか} means participation or joining in. Used as a する verb: 〜に{参加|さんか}する (to participate in ~).

COMMON COMPOUNDS:
- {参加|さんか}{者|しゃ}: participant
- {参加|さんか}{費|ひ}: participation fee
- {参加|さんか}{資格|しかく}: eligibility to participate
- {参加|さんか}{申|もう}し{込|こ}み: application to participate
- ご{参加|さんか}: your participation (honorific)

COMMON PATTERNS:
- 〜に{参加|さんか}する: to participate in ~
- {参加|さんか}を{募|つの}る: to invite participation, recruit participants
- {参加|さんか}を{見合|みあ}わせる: to refrain from participating

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {出席|しゅっせき}: attendance (being present at a meeting/class)
- {加入|かにゅう}: joining (an organization, membership)
- {参入|さんにゅう}: entry (into a market or field, more formal)
